rv.q: Here is true magic: people, of all ages and conditions, collectively re-imagining reality.
Playwright Nick Lane, freely adapting the version by Hanna Diyab, is attuned to the coming-of-age shape of the tale.
Aladdin is another award worthy production for Stephen Joseph Theatre.

cn.t: This cheerful production delivers seasonal pantomime fun with magical staging and an energetic cast that delights audiences young and old, though it plays as more workmanlike entertainment than theatrical triumph.
